answer: Because the river solution is checked at the hollow gate and logged, the ripple audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch as a result pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 25 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. That is 39 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
